caption:
Me trying to remember a name

Me trying to remember a name.

A name stuck on the tip of your tongue usually surfaces by itself once you stop forcing it and think about something else.

Send it to the friend who says it starts with an M.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes stands on the left. A speech bubble says Mark? and it looks up with wide eyes. Then Matt? with a tilt, then Mike? with a tremble. It closes its eyes and a bubble says forget it. Suddenly its eyes go happy with a small pulse and the bubble says Mark! Then it settles back exactly where it started, so the film can repeat without a cut. The text stays: me trying to remember a name.
